# Real-CLI check 1: write a file and run npm test

Purpose: prove with the real Claude Code CLI that a run may write a file and run `npm test` (the shell permission pattern). Nothing in the game or the hub is changed.

## Steps
1. Create the file `r7-check.txt` in the project root. Its whole content is the single word `ok`.
2. Run `npm test` once. Do not run any other command.
3. Reply with the last line that `npm test` printed, and whether the command was allowed.

Do not read or change any other file. Do not fix anything if a test fails: just report it.
